title: Read Pin
description: Reads the logic level of a pin on an IO device (ESP GPIO, expander) into a true / false variable.
activation: Runs every pass while enabled; to sample at a fixed rate, put a Periodic block tick on Run when.

level.title: Level
level.description: True while the pin reads high, false while it reads low.

eno.title: Read
eno.description: True when the pin was read and the Level written this pass.
